Alyssa H: Handover—I'm taking primary at 18:00 PT. Looking for confirmation on secondary/shadow coverage and any open pagers. Leaving in ~2.5h, want to make sure nothing active. @Ben K can you shadow until 20:00?
Ben K: Yep I can shadow till 20:00. No active pages from my side. If anything pings, I'll escalate to Jon. :thumbsup:
Incident Bot: [pager created] P-4821 embed-encoder error-rate spike, 3xx/5xx ratio up by 6% over 10m. Severity: P2. Links: https://ops.redwood/p/4821
Alyssa H: saw the bot—thanks. I pulled the dashboard, it's a steady uptick but not customer-facing errors yet. Will keep it in my context during the handoff. Runbook to check: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embed-encoder-latency (section: quick rollback).
Jon P: I'm on standby if it escalates. If it becomes customer-impacting, prefer fallback to v1-encoder as per runbook (I can trigger).
Ben K: Good plan. If P-4821 crosses 10% error rate or avg latency > 800ms for 5m, we call it customer-impacting and start fallback. I'll monitor metrics and logs.
Alyssa H: For handoff notes: active pager P-4821 (monitoring), config change window 15:00–16:00 showed a minor bump, rollback candidate: `deploy-tools rollback embed-encoder v2.3.1` (requires infra-eye + 1 dev).
Mike R: FYI I left a note in the runbook about the infra-eye approval ticket #INF-3321, that's prefilled if you need to rollback.
Sarah L: I can pick up from 20:00–02:00 PT if Ben needs to drop. Confirming availability now.
Ben K: Thanks Sarah — I'll ping you if things quiet down at 19:50. Otherwise handoff at 20:05.
Alyssa H: Leaving a short checklist in case I get paged during transit: 1) Check SLO page + alert thresholds 2) If error-rate > 10% open incident channel 3) Trigger fallback if > 10% and infra approves 4) Notify CS.
Alyssa H: Quick commands I use to triage:
```
# live tail errors
kubectl -n svc-embed logs -l app=embed-encoder -f --tail=200 | grep ERROR
# check rolling deploys
deploy-tools status embed-encoder
# trigger fallback (infra approval required)
deploy-tools rollback embed-encoder v1.9.4 --require-approval INF-3321
```
Jon P: Also pointer: if you need to preserve latency-sensitive customers, enable the temporary qps-rate-limit in routing: `edgectl set route embed-prioritize --qps 150` (ops-only).
Incident Bot: [update] P-4821 episilon metric stabilized but error-rate still elevated at 6.8%. No new customer 5xxs detected.
Ben K: Logging shows a handful of 502s from the encoder under spike. Correlating with a recent config: `encoder.max_batch_size=64` changed at 15:02. Rolling that back to 32 reduces tail latencies in staging.
Sarah L: If Ben ends up needing to escalate and I'm on at 20:05, I'll take over primary. Otherwise I'll be on-call ready at 20:00 for any followups.
Alyssa H: Perfect—so final coverage plan: Primary -> Alyssa until 18:00, Ben shadow 18:00–20:00 (actionable), Sarah standby 20:00–02:00. Jon is emergency escalation. Pager P-4821 is active (monitor-only). Runbook link and rollback commands posted. I'll update the oncall rota with the short note and then go offline. :wave: 
Ben K: Got it. I'll DM infra to pre-authorize INF-3321 in case we need fast rollback.
Mike R: Pre-auth sent to infra with a note "oncall: fast rollback approval for P-4821".
Alyssa H: Thanks team. Leaving now — Ben ping me if it goes red, otherwise see you tomorrow AM. :v: 
Ben K: Acknowledged. 19:50 handover check.
Incident Bot: [resolved?] No, still open — monitoring continues.
